interpretations.flicre2020: CONFIRMED independent outcome invalidity: binary history is exact thresholding of continuous history. Do not claim two independent functional axes.
interpretations.chevee2018: Two distinct dependency types: VPM-only vs VPM/POm projection outputs are complementary, and deprivation status is derived from days post manipulation. Treat as encoded covariates/labels; do not count complement as independent projection dimension.
interpretations.zhao2026: Three projection readouts form three near-exact affine pairs over 141 shared observations. Audit endpoint construction and shared operator dimensionality; near-exact correlation alone is not proof of model leakage.

scope: Numeric prefixed functional/projection/metadata features screened (up to 4500 evenly spaced rows), candidate affine/threshold relations verified on all available rows; not a proof that unflagged dataset contains no dependence.
